name: At what stage of a home remodel does electrical coordination take place?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a home remodel does electrical coordination take place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough-in electrical work must happen after wall framing is complete but before insulation and drywall are installed. Coordinating this timing correctly avoids costly delays or wall damage later. During a typical renovation, Abraham Becerra directly coordinates the licensed electrician to route wiring, place outlet boxes, and set lighting runs while the wall cavities remain open. Once the rough electrical passes and is complete, our crew immediately steps in to hang drywall, apply mud and texture, and prepare the surfaces for paint and finish carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Electrical rough-ins take place immediately after framing is complete and strictly before drywall, insulation, and wall finishes are installed.
